messages.content: Asheville is done. New one: Salt Lake City in July. Pediatric mobility seminar, Friday setup, all Saturday, Sunday lab ending around 3:45. Can you frame flights and hotels before I tell them yes?
Yes. What are the exact teaching dates and where in Salt Lake is the clinic? I’ll separate the practical options from the cheap-but-annoying ones.
Teach Saturday July 19 and Sunday July 20. Setup Friday July 18 afternoon. Clinic is in Millcreek, east side of Salt Lake. Tampa round trip.

I’d treat Thursday July 17 as the arrival day and Monday July 21 as the return. A Sunday flight is technically possible only if teardown is fast and traffic behaves, but it would make the end of the lab feel rushed. Do you want me to weight this toward schedule reliability over lowest fare?
Yes. Group by practicality. I need a room that won't make mornings harder. Monday afternoon return unless there is a magically clean Sunday escape.

Flight patterns from Tampa look like this. Best working pattern: Thursday 7:12 a.m. TPA-ATL-SLC, 72-minute connection, arrives 12:46 p.m.; Monday 2:18 p.m. SLC-DEN-TPA, arrives Tampa 10:14 p.m.; about $558 main cabin right now. It gives you Thursday afternoon for rental, grocery, and getting settled. Reasonable but tighter: Thursday 10:35 a.m. TPA-DEN-SLC, arrives 4:28 p.m.; Monday same 2:18 return; about $496. Cheaper but I would not lead with it: Thursday evening via DFW arriving 10:58 p.m.; about $422, but it makes check-in and Friday setup prep ugly. Sunday escape: 6:20 p.m. SLC-PHX-TPA after the lab, arriving after midnight; only workable if the clinic handles teardown, so I’d avoid it for now.
Morning outbound is early, but probably better than arriving at bedtime. Any hidden problem with the Monday 2:18?

No major problem. It lets you check out, eat lunch, return the car without hurrying, and still get to SLC airport with a comfortable buffer. The trade-off is the Tampa arrival is later in the evening, but it avoids the Sunday teardown gamble and a Monday morning rush.
Now hotels. They offered a host rate, but the reviews look uneven.

I compared the host-rate hotel against a suite option. Host-rate: Wasatch Clinic Hotel, about 5 minutes from the clinic, free parking, roughly $742 all-in for four nights. Recent guest score is sitting just under 4.0, with mixed notes on housekeeping timing and older HVAC. Coffee makers are listed, but the mini-fridge is not confirmed; the room page says available in some rooms. Fitness room is there, but I cannot verify a hot tub, and the pool details are vague. Suite option: Sugar House Suites, 10-12 minutes from the clinic, about $948 all-in including parking, stronger recent reviews around 4.5. Queen studio is confirmable, and the room includes a coffee maker and mini-fridge. It also has an indoor pool, hot tub, and fitness room.
If the host hotel can't confirm the fridge, don't make it the lead. Put the price difference in plain English.

The suite property is about $200-$225 more over the four-night stay after taxes and parking. That buys cleaner review history, confirmed room setup, and the recovery amenities. The host hotel buys proximity and a lower bill, but it gives back certainty on the room and amenities.
Do we need a car, or can I rideshare this one?

A compact rental is the cleaner plan unless the clinic provides a very convenient shuttle setup. The airport, suite hotel, clinic, and grocery stop are not clustered together. Rideshares would likely be $22-$35 each way at peak times, and Sunday teardown with materials could be awkward. A compact rental is pricing around $270-$310 plus hotel parking.
What should we ask the clinic before I lock travel?

Ask four things: exact Friday setup window; whether materials can stay locked overnight Friday and Saturday; weekend badge or door access plus the best load-in/parking entrance; and whether Sunday teardown can realistically be done by 4:30. I’d also ask whether they provide mats, plinths, a cart, and projector access so you do not overpack.
Draft it short. Also ask whether a Monday departure is okay from their side.

Draft: Hi, before I finalize travel for the July mobility seminar, can you confirm the Friday setup window, the load-in entrance and parking instructions, and whether I’ll have weekend badge access? Can course materials stay locked in the therapy office overnight Friday and Saturday? For Sunday, the lab is listed to end around 3:45 p.m.; is teardown usually finished by about 4:30, and do you need me available after that? I’m leaning toward a Monday afternoon flight unless you see any issue with that timing. Also, please confirm whether mats or plinths, a cart, and projector access will be provided.
Good. Tentatively, which stack are you leaning toward?

Most practical stack: Thursday morning one-stop arriving early afternoon, Monday 2:18 p.m. return, Sugar House Suites, compact rental. Not the cheapest, but it protects Friday prep and the Sunday lab day. Budget stack: midday outbound plus host hotel, maybe still with a car; cheaper but weaker on room certainty. Avoid stack: Sunday flight or late Thursday arrival.
Save the practical stack, but don't book. If they confirm storage and teardown by 4:30, we will probably book it.

Saved as tentative only. I set a fare watch on the Thursday morning outbound and Monday afternoon return, saved the cancellable suite rate link, and queued the clinic questions. I’ll wait for their answers on storage, access, load-in parking, and teardown before booking anything.
